usage: 摩洛哥 (mo1 lok3 go1) is a proper noun used to refer to the country Morocco in Africa.
When talking about countries, 摩洛哥 is treated like any other country name—never pluralized or used with articles.
You can use 摩洛哥 as the subject or object in a sentence when discussing location or origin.
It's common to say 我去過摩洛哥 (I have been to Morocco) or 我想去摩洛哥 (I want to go to Morocco) to express travel intentions.
摩洛哥 is often combined with words like '人' (people) to form 摩洛哥人 (Moroccan people).
